Free & Community Funded

WatchThis! is completely free to use. I believe great tools should be accessible to everyone. The project is supported by my amazing community through voluntary donations.

If community funding isn't enough to cover hosting costs, a Pro tier might be introduced in the future — but there will always be a generous free tier!

Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions? I've got answers.

WatchThis! is a simple browser extension that adds a 'Recommend' button to every YouTube video. When you click it, you can select friends from your list, and the video will appear as a recommendation on their YouTube homepage the next time they visit. It's like a personal video suggestion from you!

Absolutely! I take privacy seriously. WatchThis! only stores the minimal data needed to deliver recommendations. I never track your viewing habits, and all data is encrypted. Since it's open-source, you can verify this yourself by checking the code on GitHub.

WatchThis! currently supports all Chromium-based browsers including Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, and Opera. Firefox support is coming soon! Make sure you have the latest version of your browser for the best experience.

After installing the extension, click the WatchThis! icon in your browser toolbar. You can add friends by sharing a unique invite link with them. Once they accept and install the extension, you'll be connected and can start sharing videos instantly!
